dependencies.reason: Provides Config, Validate/Validated, the Podman-only ProviderFactory seam, the probe and capability checks (25-REQ-5.x) and the start-up log line that this spec modifies; 25-REQ-2.2 (gateway refused) is replaced here
Provides the lease store, lease API and lease representation that the no-leak and outage tests inspect
Provides hub's gatewayd server, wrapping backend, scrubber, loopback rule and not-found handling that gain the remote-specific behaviour
Provides the expiry sweep and shutdown destroy step that run through the remote client; the client is closed after that step

tasks.title: Add gateway_url config key, URL validation and the redacting token type
steps: Write TS-29-5..10 and TS-29-37 first and confirm they fail

In internal/sandboxes/config.go add GatewayURL (toml:"gateway_url") and GatewayToken (toml:"gateway_token") to Config; add both to the recognised sandbox.* keys so toml Undecoded() does not flag them; expand ${NAME} in both with the existing regexp expander

Add a RedactedString type (new file internal/sandboxes/redact.go) holding the token: implement fmt.Formatter (covers %v %+v %#v %s), fmt.GoStringer, slog.LogValuer, json.Marshaler and encoding.TextMarshaler, all rendering [redacted], with an unexported Reveal() method for the factory

In validate.go add validateGatewayURL: required (contains 'required') when provider==gateway and empty after expansion; url.Parse absolute; scheme https, or http only when u.Hostname() is loopback (reuse spec 27's isLoopback logic: localhost or net.ParseIP(...).IsLoopback(), no DNS); non-empty host; numeric port 1..65535; no userinfo, query, fragment; path empty or '/'
Every failure message names sandbox.gateway_url and the broken rule; any quoted URL is first stripped of userinfo (build a copy with User=nil, never print the raw string)
Append the failures to the same errors.Join collection as the other static checks; add GatewayURL and the RedactedString token to Validated

tasks.title: Validate provider value, gateway_token and other-provider keys
steps: Write TS-29-1, 11..17 first and confirm they fail

In validate.go replace the 'gateway not supported by this build' refusal (25-REQ-2.2): accept podman and gateway; any other value fails with a message naming sandbox.provider and listing both podman and gateway

Add validateGatewayToken: required (message contains 'required') when provider==gateway and empty after expansion; length >= 16 (message states 16); only bytes 0x21-0x7E (message states printable ASCII without spaces). Messages must never include the value or any part of it
Under provider gateway, each non-empty engine_binary, runtime, userns yields its own failure naming sandbox.<key> and saying it applies only to provider "podman"
Under provider podman, each non-empty gateway_url, gateway_token yields its own failure naming the key and saying it applies only to provider "gateway"; never echo the token
Collect all of these through the same errors.Join as the other static failures (no early return)
Write the TS-29-14 property test with a seeded random generator (valid, short, invalid-byte, empty tokens) checking no substring of length >= 8 appears in err.Error()

tasks.title: Add the gateway factory seam, remote client build and single-List probe with scrubbed errors
steps: Write TS-29-2, 3, 18..22 first and confirm they fail; build a shared test harness helper (internal/sandboxes/remote_harness_test.go) that starts an in-process gatewayd.New(Config{Backend: recording wrapper over local.Unisolated, Tokens: static token}) on 127.0.0.1:0 with Shutdown and restart-on-same-address support, counting List/Create/Destroy and recording the Spec and seen tokens, with injectable failing Create
In go.mod/go.sum make sure agentkit-go sandbox/gateway and gatewayd are required for non-test code under the existing ../agentkit-go replace (go mod tidy)

In provider.go define type GatewayFactory func(url string, opts gateway.Options) (sandbox.Provider, error) and DialGateway = gateway.Dial as the production value; thread the factory through Start and Init next to the existing Podman factory, without changing the Podman path

In service.go: after static validation passes, when provider==gateway call the factory exactly once with the validated gateway_url and the token revealed from the redacting value; never call the Podman factory or run any binary; when validation fails call no factory and issue no List
Run 25's probe unchanged: exactly one List under context.WithTimeout(10s), no Create/Destroy

On factory or probe error return an error beginning 'sandbox:' that names sandbox.provider, sandbox.gateway_url and sandbox.gateway_token, and includes the client error text with the token replaced by [redacted] and URL userinfo removed (reuse the scrubber from spec 27, or a minimal scrub helper in scrub.go if not yet present)

TS-29-3: put a sentinel `podman` script on PATH writing a marker file and assert the marker does not exist and the podman factory count is 0; TS-29-22 uses a stub whose List blocks until ctx cancel and asserts 10s <= elapsed <= 11s

tasks.title: Snapshot remote capabilities once and keep profile rules identical across providers
steps: Write TS-29-4, 23..26 first and confirm they fail

In service.go wrap the built provider in a small type (capsSnapshot) that reads Capabilities() exactly once after a successful probe and returns the cached value from Capabilities() thereafter, with no call to the remote
Run 25's network_modes check (25-REQ-5.4) and per-profile sandbox.CheckSpec checks (25-REQ-5.5..5.7) against the snapshot with messages unchanged; no gateway-specific wording in those errors

Make hub's wrapping backend (spec 27, backend.go) answer Capabilities() by narrowing the service's snapshot (network modes limited to hub's configured set) without calling the remote; verify it works while the remote is shut down

TS-29-4: table of profile sets run through Start with provider podman and provider gateway using injected factories returning the same stub; assert identical acceptance and identical profile-related message text
TS-29-23: counting stub proves Capabilities called once across Start and 20 backend Capabilities() calls

tasks.title: Map remote not-found and refusal statuses and forbid Create retries
steps: Write TS-29-31..33 first and confirm they fail

Add helper isNotFound(err) = errors.Is(err, sandbox.ErrNotFound) || status.Code(err)==codes.NotFound (google.golang.org/grpc/status) and use it in Backend.Destroy, the DELETE destroy path (delete_destroy.go) and the spec 28 expiry sweep / shutdown step, replacing the bare errors.Is checks

In backend.go add mapRemoteError: for errors from the remote client with status Unauthenticated or PermissionDenied return status.Error(codes.Unavailable, scrubbed message); apply it to Create, Destroy and the handle methods; spec 27's lease outcomes stay unchanged (Create -> failed, Destroy -> active, DELETE -> 502)
Each time a mapping happens log exactly one slog error record naming sandbox.gateway_token, never its value
Backend.Create calls the remote client exactly once; no retry loop or retry wrapper anywhere

TS-29-31 covers sentinel (wrapped) and gRPC NotFound against Backend.Destroy, DELETE and the sweep; TS-29-32 runs Unauthenticated and PermissionDenied from Create and Destroy and counts error records; TS-29-33 asserts the recording remote sees two Creates for two caller Creates, one of which fails

tasks.title: Extend the scrub set with token, URL and host and prove nothing leaks
steps: Write TS-29-34..36 and 38 first and confirm they fail

Add Service.scrubValues(): for provider gateway append the revealed token, the configured gateway_url string and url.Host to the secret and env values spec 27 already scrubs; unchanged for podman; feed it to the single scrub call-site used for lease error, log, audit event and gateway/HTTP error text
Ensure the start-up info record still carries only attributes provider and profiles, and that no metric label or profile-listing/error body can contain the token

TS-29-35: remote Create returns an error containing the token and 127.0.0.1:<port>; capture slog.Default, audit emitter, gateway error, lease JSON, HTTP bodies and assert none contains the token or host
TS-29-36: fetch profile listing, an error body, a lease response and /metrics and assert no token; assert the single info record attribute keys are exactly {provider, profiles}
TS-29-38: property test over generated configs and probe failures whose text embeds token, userinfo and URL; assert Start's error never contains token or userinfo

tasks.title: Serve leases over the remote provider under hub's single token
steps: Write TS-29-27..30 first and confirm they fail

Using the harness from task 3, build a test fixture: in-process remote, hub Service via Init with real gateway.Dial, in-memory SQLite lease store (sql.Open("sqlite", ":memory:"), SetMaxOpenConns(1)), echo lease API with apikit.SetAuthInfo test middleware, hub gatewayd on its own 127.0.0.1:0

Confirm Backend.Create passes the lease's image/TTL and Env = profile env merged with resolved secrets to the remote client and that only hub's token reaches the remote (record tokens in the remote authenticator); fix any gap in spec 27 wiring found
Confirm lease representation gateway_url equals hub's own gateway URL and differs from sandbox.gateway_url
Verify second Create under a lease token is FailedPrecondition and an unminted token is Unauthenticated with the remote's Create count unchanged
Verify DELETE and the caller's Close both destroy the remote box (remote List empty) and revoke the lease token (later dial is Unauthenticated)

tasks.title: Report remote outages as recorded outcomes and recover on the same address
steps: Write TS-29-39..44 first and confirm they fail
Reuse the task 7 fixture; add a counting gateway factory wrapping the real gateway.Dial
Remote down: lease POST returns its success status and profile listing returns 200 (neither calls the provider)
A caller Create while the remote is down errors and leaves the lease failed with an error field free of token and host
DELETE of an active lease answers 502 sandbox_provider_error and leaves the lease active with its token still valid; Close returns a non-nil error and leaves the lease active
Expiry sweep (spec 28): while down, one warn/error log per failed destroy and lease stays active; after the remote restarts on the same port the next sweep destroys the box and ends the lease
Restart the remote on the same 127.0.0.1:<port> and assert the next Create succeeds with factory call count still 1; add no redial, monitor or circuit breaker code anywhere

TS-29-45: stub client records Destroy/Close order with two active boxes and asserts [destroy, destroy, close]; a non-Closer stub shuts down with no error
